name: d3rlpy benchmark
description: In this paper, we introduce d3rlpy, an open-sourced offline deep reinforcement learning (RL) library for Python. d3rlpy supports a set of offline deep RL algorithms as well as off-policy online algorithms via a fully documented plug-and-play API. To address a reproducibility issue, we conduct a large-scale benchmark with D4RL and Atari 2600 dataset to ensure implementation quality and provide experimental scripts and full tables of results. The d3rlpy source code can be found on GitHub: \url{https://github.com/takuseno/d3rlpy}.
reputation: Widely used as an open-source offline RL library and reproducibility benchmark, especially for comparing implementations on D4RL and Atari tasks.
notes: This is primarily a non-LLM reinforcement learning benchmark/library rather than a single fixed leaderboard; scores vary substantially by dataset, algorithm, and environment.
